title: Quantify the L3 gate: governance-report command (risk-evidence coverage + bypass merges)
spec: The L3 maturity gate ('100% of PRs carry required risk-evidence routes; 0 silent-bypass merges') has no measurement. Add a governance-report command to the GitHub governance CLI that, over a merged-PR window, computes risk-evidence coverage (share of merged PRs whose bodies satisfy the evidence routes for the areas they touch), counts silent-bypass commits (commits on the default branch that belong to no PR), renders both against their targets, and writes the usual JSON+MD evidence bundle. Wire a pnpm alias and self-check coverage.
